units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 6:9">Kil. VI, 9</cite> <he>המוֹתֵחַ זמורה וכ׳</he> if one trains a vine from one tree to another.
<cite ref="Shabbat 75a:2">Sabb. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>המותח חוט וכ׳</he> he who pulls the thread of a seam (bringing the ends closer together), v. infra.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 3">Gen. R. s. 3</cite>, a. e. <he>שלא תאמר מיכאל היה מותח וכ׳</he> lest you say, Michael stretched (the world) in the south &c., v. <cite ref="M00251"><he>מָדַד</he></cite>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 24">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXIV</cite> <cite ref="M02257"><he>מְמַתֵּחַ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:25">Y. Ber. I, 2ᵈ</cite> top <he>אדם מותח אהל וכ׳</he> when one stretches a tent-cover, in course of time it becomes loose; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 12">Gen. R. s. 12</cite>, end; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 314">Yalk. Is. 314</cite>.—

Gen. R. s. 10, end, v. Nif.—[Yalk. Prov. 961 סופו להיות מותח v. מָתַק.]—Part. pass. מָתוּחַ; f. מְתוּחָה; pl. מְתוּחִים, מְתוּחִין; מְתוּחוֹת stretched, extended; (of a bow) bent; trnsf. (of judgment) ready to be discharged, aimed.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 35">Gen. R. s. 35</cite> <he>אותה מדת הדין שהיתה מ׳ כנגד … ומְתָחָהּ וכ׳</he> that very judgment which was aimed against Israel, did the Lord turn and aim against the Egyptians.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:7:15">Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᶜ</cite> top <he>הדין מ׳ כנגד וכ׳</he> judgment is ready against the whole family.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 38">Pesik. R. s. 38</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: same, esp. to straiten straps; to bring objects closer together.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 1:8">M. Kat. I, 8</cite> <he>אף מְמַתְּהִין</he> you may also straigten (bed-straps).
<cite ref="Moed Katan 10a:3">Ib. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>וממתחין שאם</he> … <he>מְמַתְּחוֹ</he> ‘you may stretch’, means when it (a strap) is lax, you may straiten it; Y. ib. I, 80ᵈ bot.

Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. IV, 10 מחוסרין … למַתֵּחַ need … stretching. Midr. Till. l. c., v. supra.—Y. Sabb. XIII, beg. 14ᵃ המְמַתֵּחַ צדדין (ed. Krot. הממחה צדדיו, corr. acc.) he who brings the ends of two pieces close together (by pulling the thread up and knotting it), v. supra; Y. Kil. IX, end, 32ᵈ המְמַתֵּיחַ צדדין (or המַמְתִּיחַ Hif.; not צדדיו); a. e.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 38b:2">Snh. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>נִמְתְּחוּ אבריו</he> his limbs were stretched (shaped); (Ab. d’ R. N. ch. I <he>נתקשרו</he>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 15">Yalk. Gen. 15</cite>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 16:17">Ib. 16</cite> <he>היו נִמְתָּחִין והולכין</he> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 16:17">ib.</cite> also <cite ref="M00703"><he>מוֹתְחִין</he></cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10">Gen. R. s. 10</cite>, end <he>מותחין</he>) they (the works of creation) continued to extend (develop). Y. Ber. I, 2ᶜ bot. <he>יִמָּתֵחַ הרקיע</he> (or <he>יִמְתַּח</he>) let the firmament be stretched out.
R. Hash. 22ᵇ יִמָּתֵחַ על העמוד shall be stretched on the pillory. Y. Hor. II, 46ᵈ נִמְתְּחָה הקשת the bow was bent (euphem. for erection).

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 796">Yalk. Ps. 796</cite> <he>נמתחה החרב</he> the sword (of judgment) was drawn; (Tanḥ. B’midb. 7 <he>נמשכה</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 796">ib.</cite> ed. Bub. 7 <he>נשמטה</he>).

senses.gloss: <cite ref="M03038">same</cite>. Tanḥ. Ḥayé 3 <he>והיו הולכין ומִתְמַתְּחִין וכ׳</he> they would have gone on spreading &c.
